pages.title: PAW Patrol Rubble Wearing His Construction Hard Hat and Pup Pack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows PAW Patrol Rubble wearing his construction hard hat and pup pack, standing with a broad smile against a mostly blank background. The pack has a small jointed shovel above one shoulder. Large face and vest sections surround smaller paw badges, curved straps, and equipment joints.

pages.title: PAW Patrol Rubble Beside His Bulldozer at the Lookout Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: PAW Patrol Rubble stands beside his bulldozer at the Lookout tower in this printable coloring page, with the machine's toothed bucket filling one side of the scene. His pup pack carries an outlined wrench. Repeated track wheels, lifting-arm joints, and the tower's spiral slide provide smaller details around the seated pup.

pages.title: PAW Patrol Rubble Clearing a Mountain Rockslide with His Bulldozer Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts PAW Patrol Rubble clearing a mountain rockslide with his bulldozer, pushing angular boulders off a winding road beneath a steep cliff. pages.title: PAW Patrol Rubble Filling a Road Pothole with His Pup-pack Shovel Coloring Page
